title: Tiny, nonfunctional birdhouse
text: I'm not at all happy about the first and last set I'll be getting from Surprise Ride. It was a paint your own birdhouse kit that came with a tiny 4" birdhouse. If it were a large, functional birdhouse that we could actually use outside for our feathered friends, then I would have been happy. It came with a small slide puzzle, glue, paint, sponge, brush, stickers and feathers to decorate the birdhouse. There was also a book that would be good for the younger child, surely not any child over 8. This set is definitely not for children up to 12 like the description says and definitely not worth $25 a month.
label: negative
